newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor plans basic power rate reduction.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor plans basic power rate reduction.

text.p: The state-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) will ask the Energy Regulatory Board (ERB) to approve a reduction in basic power rates by three centavos to 13 centavos per kilowatt hour, a top Napocor official said on Thursday.
Napocor president Guido A. Delgado said improvements in the reliability and operations of existing power plants will enable Napocor to bring down power rates.
Delgado said the application will be filed with the ERB in the next two weeks.
